Find the tempo of any song — tap along to the beat and get a live BPM readout with beat-interval stats.

Tip: press the Space bar to tap. Pausing 3+ seconds resets the count.

📖 How to use

  1. Tap the big button (or press Space) on every beat.
  2. Watch the live BPM update with each tap.
  3. Check min/max to see how steady the tempo is.
  4. Tap Reset to start over.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many taps do I need?

Tap at least twice; more taps give a steadier average. The last 16 taps are used.

Does it show tap consistency?

Yes — the readout shows the average BPM plus the fastest/slowest recent taps.

What if I pause?

If you stop for more than 3 seconds, the tap history resets automatically.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — big tap area, fully mobile friendly.
